evidence.note: Legend above the chart maps the white swatch to Q2 2026 and the pale green swatch to Q3 2026; each Q2 bar carries its value (86%, 85%, 85%, 87%).
Q3 bars are added in pale green, each labelled with its value (81%, 70%, 74%, 87%); the y-axis is labelled 0%, 50%, 100%.
The green target line is labelled directly as 'Target 90%'.
At the small size the legend, bar values and target label are all still visible and readable.
The Insight overlay is text only and adds no new colour encoding.

rationale: Both colour encodings (Q2 white and Q3 green) are explained by a legend, and every bar also shows its value. The one other coloured mark, the target line, is labelled directly with its value. No meaning depends on colour alone at any step or size.
